variants.title: 555 timer as an astable and a monostable: a 47 nF capacitor
variants.sample: Unknown timing capacitor from the E6 series (47 nF)

variants.note: A smaller capacitor makes the astable run faster and the monostable pulse shorter.

source.title: IEC 60063 preferred values (E6 series): 47 nF; NE555 timing relations (TI datasheet)
